title: Pixar has already made the film about you
dek: No trivia, no release dates. Twelve questions about work, family and what you're holding on to, and the studio will tell you which film it made.

questions.prompt: The first scene of your life:

options.label: A bedroom where the toys have opinions
An ocean, and one small fish going the wrong way
A house with too many memories in it
A kitchen that smells like it's about to work

questions.prompt: Your job, if you had one:

options.label: Keeping a system running that nobody notices
Making sure the family is fine
Talking someone through a very bad day
Doing the thing everyone said was impossible
Go on the adventure
Stay and fix what's broken
A shelf crowded with things you can't throw away
options.alt: A shelf crowded with old games and objects

options.label: Underwater, light coming down from above
options.alt: A slow river running past a quiet bank

options.label: A city at night, seen from a rooftop
A candlelit table with food already on it
options.alt: A dinner table lit by candles

questions.prompt: Plot the size of your story.
questions.helper: Across: stay home, or go far. Up: keep it small, or aim enormous.

questions.prompt: Rank what the story is really about.
questions.helper: First place is the one that makes you cry.

items.label: Letting go of something you kept too long
Doing the work nobody claps for

results.name: Toy Story
results.tagline: You are somebody's favourite and it's complicated
results.blurb: You are the one who has been around long enough to know how things work, and you are not entirely at peace with being replaced. Your real talent is showing up for someone else's big moment and staying in the room afterwards. You keep the old things for a reason.
strengths: Good in a crisis involving a window
Knows the value of being there
results.watchOut: You hold on so tightly that the next chapter can't start. Loosen your grip.

results.name: Finding Nemo
results.tagline: One small brave thing, then another
results.blurb: You are the one who gets lost and keeps swimming anyway. You're smaller than the problem and you go first regardless, which is genuinely brave and slightly reckless. Your story is about growing up in public, badly, and eventually getting somewhere.
results.watchOut: You swim off alone to prove something. Tell someone where you're going.

results.name: Up
results.tagline: The adventure was the person beside you
results.blurb: You have a plan from years ago and a life that got in the way of it. You are warmer than you look, absurdly determined, and carrying more grief than you mention. The thing you're chasing is probably not the thing you actually want.
strengths: Kind to people who need it
results.watchOut: You can spend years on a plan that was really about someone. Look up.

results.name: WALL·E
results.tagline: Still doing the job nobody's watching
results.blurb: You have been quietly keeping something going long after anyone stopped noticing. Your curiosity is enormous, your toolkit is small, and you would follow one interesting thing across the galaxy. You find value in objects everybody else threw away.
results.watchOut: You'll do the work alone forever without asking for company. Say hello first.

results.name: Ratatouille
results.tagline: Anyone can, and you're proving it
results.blurb: You have a thing you're unreasonably good at and a room full of people who've already decided you shouldn't be here. You don't argue; you cook. Your gift is making something simple taste like it took a lifetime, and your problem is trusting anyone else to taste it.
strengths: Proves it instead of saying it
results.watchOut: You hide behind the work. Take the credit occasionally.

results.name: The Incredibles
results.tagline: The job is family, and the family is a job
results.blurb: You are the one holding a household and a calling at the same time, and you are bad at admitting which one is winning. You are more capable than your day job suggests and more tired than you let on. Your loyalty is enormous and your patience is not infinite.
strengths: Carries more than one life at once
Protective to the point of strategy
results.watchOut: You keep the secret and call it protection. Share the problem.

results.name: Inside Out
results.tagline: You've been managing feelings since you were small
results.blurb: Your inner world is a whole city with a control room and a maintenance problem. You notice what you're feeling and then keep it tidy for everyone else, which is both a gift and a habit you should break. The sad one isn't the enemy.
strengths: Good at remembering the good years
results.watchOut: You let one feeling run the console alone. Let the sad one speak.

results.name: Coco
results.blurb: You are the one who remembers who was here before, and why the table has that particular chair. Music, food and the names of relatives all matter to you more than you usually admit. Your loyalty runs backwards as well as forwards.
results.watchOut: You keep the dead close and the living at arm's length. Invite someone over.

results.name: Monsters, Inc.
results.tagline: What you were told to be afraid of is just doing a job
results.blurb: You are good at something you were told was scary, and you've come to like the people you were supposed to frighten. You're a lot softer than your job description, and you're very funny about it. You'd rather make someone laugh than prove a point.
strengths: Finds the person behind the role
results.watchOut: You argue to the end and then change your mind too late. Say it earlier.

results.name: Soul
results.tagline: The point was the ordinary afternoon
results.blurb: You've been chasing the big thing so long you've forgotten to notice the small ones. You are thoughtful, funny, slightly melancholy, and genuinely good at what you do. The answer you're looking for is usually already in your pocket.
results.watchOut: You wait for your life to start. It's already 4pm on a Tuesday.
